item.text: {"search_note":"I found some real technocratic appointments in 2024, but they were embedded in a clear loyalist structure. I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Putin built a genuinely merit-based cabinet insulated from security insiders, bodyguards, family ties, or patronage. I also did not find credible 2024 evidence of family members directly running core ministries; the pattern was loyalists, ex-security personnel, and trusted insiders rather than literal family rule.","evidence":[{"title":"Putin names technocrat as defence chief to help steer Russia’s war economy","publisher":"Reuters via The Irish Times","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2024/05/13/putin-names-technocrat-as-defence-chief-to-help-steer-russias-war-economy/","summary":"Putin replaced Shoigu with economist Andrei Belousov, a real technocratic move that suggests some preference for competence in wartime management. The same reporting says Belousov was also loyal to Putin and had no independent political base, so this is only weak evidence for merit over patronage.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.3"]},{"title":"Putin taps economist Andrei Belousov to lead defense ministry in wartime","publisher":"The Washington Post","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/05/13/andrei-beluosov-defense-minister-russia/","summary":"Analysts described Belousov as calm, professional, and unusually competent for the industrial-policy camp. That supports the case that Putin sometimes picks capable administrators, but it does not show a broader break from loyalist staffing.","question_ids":["7B.5"]},{"title":"Putin appoints Patrushev and Dyumin as Kremlin aides","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-05-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-appoints-patrushev-and-dyumin-as-kremlin-aides/2084276/","summary":"Putin elevated Nikolai Patrushev and Alexei Dyumin, both long-time security insiders, while keeping core staff figures like Vaino, Gromov, Kiriyenko, and Peskov in place. Dyumin is a former bodyguard, which is strong evidence for a trusted-loyalist staffing model.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.3","7B.4"]},{"title":"Putin appoints former Security Council Secretary Nikolai Patrushev as presidential aide","publisher":"Meduza","date":"2024-05-14","url":"https://meduza.io/en/news/2024/05/14/putin-appoints-former-security-council-secretary-nikolai-patrushev-as-presidential-aide","summary":"Patrushev’s move out of the Security Council did not remove him from the inner circle; it shifted him into another Kremlin role while Dyumin, a longtime ally and former bodyguard, also moved closer to the center of power. This looks like elite recycling, not fresh professionalization.","question_ids":["7B.5"]},{"title":"Russia detains former deputy defence minister for suspected fraud as corruption probe deepens","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-09-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-opens-fraud-case-against-former-deputy-defence-minister-3592856","summary":"The defense ministry personnel and procurement sphere was still producing major corruption cases in 2024, including arrests of senior officials. That weakens any claim that Putin’s staffing system reliably selected clean, professional managers over loyal insiders.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.4"]},{"title":"Russia detains ally of Defence Minister Shoigu for corruption","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-04-24","url":"https://theprint.in/world/russia-detains-ally-of-defence-minister-shoigu-for-corruption/2054598/","summary":"A Shoigu deputy was detained on bribery charges, showing serious graft in the top defense layer. That is evidence of a patronage system rather than a meritocratic appointment filter.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.4"]},{"title":"Russia 2024 Freedom in the World","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says many elites fulfill Putin’s aims and receive contracts and protection from prosecution in return for loyalty. It also says state power and private property are intimately connected and that officials can use office to amass property, which directly supports a cronyism reading.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.4","7B.3"]},{"title":"Russia 2024 Nations in Transit","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2024","summary":"Freedom House says the regime sustains itself through distribution of economic assets to Putin’s allies and that transparency is weak. That is strong background evidence for loyalist staffing and patronage-based governance rather than independent professional appointments.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.4","7B.3"]},{"title":"Putin lets economically significant entities limit information disclosures","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-29","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001","summary":"Widening secrecy for powerful firms makes it easier to hide insider privilege and reduces outside scrutiny. This does not itself prove who was appointed, but it fits a broader environment where loyalists and connected actors are protected.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.3","7B.4"]},{"title":"Russian central bank keeps rates on hold after Putin’s call for balance","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-12-20","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135","summary":"Putin did not simply overrule the central bank and instead publicly backed tight policy, which is weak evidence that he sometimes defers to expert judgment. This is the best counterexample I found, but it is about macro policy, not a broader merit-based personnel system.","question_ids":["7B.5","7B.2"]}]}
